component.name: System Update
component.summary: Keep Ubuntu and your apps up to date

description.p: System Update installs every kind of update an Ubuntu computer gets, in one place, and tidies up afterwards. You see what is available before anything changes, and choose what to include.

ul.li: System packages from APT, including security updates

description.p: Afterwards it can remove unused packages, the package cache, old snap revisions and unused Flatpak runtimes, and trim the system journal.

Progress is shown for every step, with the full output one click away. Nothing ever stops to ask a question, installing packages is never interrupted, and every run is logged and kept in a history. A command-line interface is included for scripts and timers.
System Update is now a desktop app.

ul.li: See every available update before installing: system packages, snaps, Flatpak apps and firmware
Live progress for each step, with the full command output one click away
Stop after the current step at any time; package installation is never interrupted
A reminder when the computer needs a restart, and a history of every update run
A command line that accepts the options of system-update.sh, for timers and scripts
